tools.name: get_challenge_capabilities
tools.description: Use this when an agent needs to describe the public FlightSweeper WebMCP challenge and its synthetic-only boundary. Do not use it for real travel transactions or private data.

tools.name: get_flight_tool_contracts
tools.description: Use this when an agent needs to list the browser-local WebMCP tool contracts without executing or mutating a mission. Do not use it for real travel transactions or private data.

tools.name: get_sandbox_inventory
tools.description: Use this when an agent needs to describe the bounded synthetic inventory used by the challenge. Do not use it for real travel transactions or private data.

tools.name: get_safety_model
tools.description: Use this when an agent needs to describe FlightSweeper's application-enforced policy, revocation, and idempotency model. Do not use it for real travel transactions or private data.
